subject.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue

question: Should durable wakes survive a session-generation reset and target the current session for the canonical key, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107559 replace this PR as the landing branch?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent either with exact-generation fencing or intentional current-session delivery, but that choice changes session-state and message-delivery semantics; the two open stacked PRs also require one maintainer-selected canonical branch.

options.title: Use the refreshed PR
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107559 canonical after it carries equivalent live proof and tests the chosen session-generation policy, then close this predecessor.

options.title: Keep this PR canonical
options.body: Land this proven branch after rebasing the stack and documenting the intentional reset behavior, then close the refreshed duplicate.

options.title: Pause the handoff
options.body: Keep durable wakes inspection-only until maintainers define a different lifecycle owner or generation-fencing contract.

recommendation.title: Use the refreshed PR
recommendation.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107559 canonical after it carries equivalent live proof and tests the chosen session-generation policy, then close this predecessor.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns adjacent queue-delivery success, drop, and fallback semantics and is the strongest available history signal for routing this decision.
